subject.name: Mozilla Protocol
subject.audience: visitors to Mozilla's and Firefox's websites
subject.primaryJob: give Mozilla sites one set of roles and components with room for a brand's own voice
sources: one set of roles across two type scales (P02)

principles: default elements, hard edges: the outlined button (P03)

territories.name: The open web
territories.description: A plain page of black text, bold navigation labels and one blue outlined action.

muse.name: a browser's default link
muse.take: plain blue that plainly means action (P03)

signature.reason: P03's only action is a square blue outline, the muse's plain blue given a hard edge

rationale.grounding.primary: Inferred, not stated by the source. Three study boards are thin evidence. Departs from the canon's flat scale (P02).
rationale.type.faces: Stand-in for display: Mozilla Headline and Metropolis (P01) are outside the catalogue. Inter is Firefox's text face; Mozilla Text is not in the catalogue.
rationale.form.space: standard spacing, not the canon's tight (P03)
rationale.color.anchors.0: Sampled from P03, not a printed value. Mozilla's and Firefox's own palettes aren't in this study.
